tools.name: integration_json-schema-generate
tools.description: Build a schema from supplied examples before you connect or ship an integration. Required properties are keys present on every example. Whole numbers are integer. Additional properties stay allowed. Call with optional payload, example, examples, schema, source, target and others. Returns checkedAt,

tools.name: integration_json-schema-validate
tools.description: Check a payload against a supplied schema using the documented subset before you connect or ship an integration. Each failure has a JSON pointer. Unsupported keywords are reported and not applied. Call with optional payload, example, examples, schema, source, target and others. Returns checkedAt, co

tools.name: integration_response-normalize
tools.description: Trim string edges and sort object keys before you connect or ship an integration. Types are not changed, fields are not removed, and each change is listed. Call with optional payload, example, examples, schema, source, target and others. Returns checkedAt, codeExecuted, externalCall, valuesInvented,

tools.name: integration_payload-transform
tools.description: Apply rename, copy, pick, omit, cast, and default in order before you connect or ship an integration. A missing source is reported and not invented. A default is written only when the path is absent. Call with optional payload, example, examples, schema, source, target and others. Returns checkedAt,

tools.name: integration_field-map-generate
tools.description: Map a path that exists on both sides, or a field name that matches one leaf on each side after splitting camel case and snake case before you connect or ship an integration. No value is copied. Call with optional payload, example, examples, schema, source, target and others. Returns checkedAt, codeE

tools.name: integration_contract-compare
tools.description: List schema changes before you connect or ship an integration. A change is labeled breaking or non-breaking only when side is request or response. Title and description are ignored. Call with optional payload, example, examples, schema, source, target and others. Returns checkedAt, codeExecuted, ext

tools.name: integration_version-compatibility-check
tools.description: Order dotted numeric versions and compare the supplied schemas before you connect or ship an integration. A version number alone is not treated as compatible. The payload is checked against the later schema. Call with optional payload, example, examples, schema, source, target and others. HTTP 200 w

tools.name: integration_diagnose
tools.description: Generate a schema from examples, validate the payload, map fields that exist, compare contracts, and apply documented transforms before you connect or ship an integration. No external API is called. Call with optional payload, example, examples, schema, source, target and others. Returns checkedAt,
